text:
Maria: quick sync — we need to decide how to represent precision tiers in the public API vs leaving calibration automatic. tradeoffs?
Ben: i'd push for an explicit `precision_profile` param but with strong server-side fallbacks. saves callers from complex logic.
Jun: agree but want per-model defaults. naive param + global flag will cause messy overrides.
Sanjay: think about rollout: start explicit opt-in for fp8/int8, run calibration offline, then enable auto-negotiate for traffic if model passes.
Olga: what about metrics? we need a small, consistent eval harness to gate auto-enable. e.g., next-token perplexity + end-task eval (qa F1) on a holdout.
Ben: yep. propose two gates: 1) calibration residuals < threshold, 2) end-task drop <= 2% relative. both must pass.
Maria: concrete API sketch:
```
POST /v1/generate
{ "model": "redwood-open-7b", "precision_profile": "fp8.speed" /* optional */, "auto_precision": true /* optional */ }
```
If `precision_profile` supplied -> honor if compatible, else 400. If `auto_precision` true -> runtime can pick a safer variant if needed.
Jun: runtime-compatible check is important. we should surface `precision_compat` in model catalog and have the control plane validate at request time.
Sanjay: also need runtime telemetry to record "requested_profile", "served_profile", "quality_delta" per eval-set so we can detect regressions quickly.
Olga: telemetry schema suggestion: `{route, model, requested_profile, served_profile, eval_tag, quality_metric_name, quality_delta}`. small payload, aggregated.
Ben: ops question — if we allow `auto_precision`, do we accept serving fp8 on Dedicated? customers will expect predictability. maybe disable auto on Dedicated unless explicitly allowed in account settings.
Maria: agreed. Dedicated defaults to strict honor of `precision_profile` unless account opt-in (compliance/security). Hosted tiers can enable auto.
Jun: fallback semantics: if fp8 fails safety checks mid-request (OOM or numerics) runtime should retry with safe profile (int8 or fp16) transparently, but surface a warning field in response and increment a metric.
Sanjay: important: retries must be cheap. prefer pre-warming cache for safe profile or keep KV cache transferable if possible. otherwise latency spikes.
Olga: pre-warm plan: maintain 1 warm worker per model+safe-profile when traffic > X rps. include that in cost model.
Ben: on cost/benefit — quick numbers from experiment: fp8 path reduced tokens/sec cost by ~35% vs fp16 on chat workload, median latency unchanged, 95p increased by ~12ms due to dequant patch.
Maria: great. we should capture cost savings per route in Console so customers can make informed choice.
Jun: interface boundaries: control plane decides which quantized artifacts are available for a model (artifact metadata), runtime decides per-request which kernel/variant to use. keep the negotiation API minimal.
Sanjay: agree — avoid pushing calibration logic to callers. provide a calibration job API:
```
POST /v1/models/:id/calibrate
{ "profile": "fp8.speed", "samples": 200, "eval_set": "prod-holdout-v1" }
```
returns calibration report + pass/fail.
Olga: we should version calibration reports and surface them in model catalog so can audit why a profile was enabled.
Ben: rollout playbook: feature-flag `precision.auto.v1` -> canary region -> 1% traffic -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with daily quality checks. revert if quality_delta > threshold.
ci-bot: deploy canary precision autoscaler to us-west-2 succeeded (canary id: pc-2026-03-05). :white_check_mark:
Maria: follow-ups: (1) write RFC for api surface + error codes, (2) add telemetry schema to telemetry repo, (3) prototype calibration job API and run on 3 models, (4) product: UI for route-level precision opt-in.
Jun: i'll take the RFC. Ben: i'll own telemetry and cost dashboard integration. Sanjay: i'll prototype calibration job. Olga: i'll draft rollout playbook and cost model.
Maria: thanks all. I'll sync with sales/ent teams about Dedicated defaults.
Ben: one more note — keep an escape hatch: "force_safe=true" for legal/compliance requests.
Maria: noted. closing thread, will open RFC PR later today. :rocket:
